image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a red lionfish (Pterois volitans) swimming over a textured coral reef background. The fish displays characteristic vertical reddish-brown and white stripes across its body and fins. Its dorsal spines are fully extended in a fan-like arrangement, and its large pectoral fins are spread wide. The lighting highlights the translucency of the fin rays against the darker, mottled green and brown reef substrate.
